name: perimeterlens
description: Free, open-source, zero-dependency CLI that gives you a single passive exposure read on your own domain: forgotten subdomains (certificate-transparency), email spoofability (SPF/DMARC/DKIM/BIMI/MTA-STS/DNSSEC), and TLS certificate health. Self-scan only. Not a header grader (use Mozilla HTTP Observatory or SecurityHeaders.com for that).
